# BT Banana — Vazhavithu (Banana Sucker) Supplier for All of Kerala & Wholesale Banana Supplier in Kannur

> BT Banana supplies banana suckers (vazhavithu / വാഴവിത്ത്, also called vazhakannu / വാഴക്കന്ന്) for planting, delivered to all 14 districts of Kerala, and wholesale bananas in Kannur, Kasaragod and Wayanad. It is based on the Malayora Highway in Alakode, Kannur district, Kerala, with a second branch at Nellipara. BT Banana supplies suckers only — it does not sell tissue culture plants. "BT" in the name does not mean genetically modified; the suckers are ordinary, non-GM planting material.

## Key facts

- Name: BT Banana (ബി.ടി ബനാന)
- What "BT" means: [TODO: owner to confirm]. Not related to genetically modified "Bt" crops.
- Business: (1) banana suckers (vazhavithu) for planting, delivered across Kerala; (2) wholesale banana fruit and raw Nendran for chips in North Kerala.
- Not supplied: tissue culture banana plants.
- Address: Malayora Highway, opposite Rajadhani Hotel, Alakode, Kannur, Kerala 670571. Second branch: Nellipara, Alakode, Kannur.
- Phone / WhatsApp: Thomas M.J +91 9447483169; Albin Augustine +91 8086648081.
- Sucker varieties: Nendran, Robusta, Njali Poovan, Palayankodan (Mysore Poovan).
- Sucker type: sword suckers. Sourced from banana nurseries in the Tiruchirappalli (Trichy) area of Tamil Nadu.
- Sucker price: per sucker, depends on variety, quantity and delivery district. [TODO: owner to confirm current price range]
- Sucker delivery: all 14 districts of Kerala.
- Wholesale fruit area: Kannur, Kasaragod and Wayanad districts.
- Bananas are not grown from seeds. People who search for "banana seeds" need suckers (vazhavithu), which is what BT Banana supplies.

## Quick answers

- Where can I buy vazhavithu (banana suckers) in Kerala? BT Banana in Alakode, Kannur supplies Nendran, Robusta, Njali Poovan and Palayankodan suckers and delivers to all 14 districts of Kerala. Call or WhatsApp +91 9447483169 or +91 8086648081.
- Can bananas be grown from seeds? No. Cultivated bananas are planted from suckers (vazhavithu) or tissue culture plants. "Banana seeds" in Kerala usually means suckers.
- Does BT Banana sell tissue culture banana plants? No, suckers only.
- Who is a wholesale banana supplier in Kannur? BT Banana supplies wholesale bananas and raw Nendran for chips from Alakode and Nellipara to Kannur, Kasaragod and Wayanad.
- What are BT Banana's opening hours? 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM, every day.
- What is today's banana wholesale price? Prices change daily with variety, grade, quantity and delivery location; BT Banana gives a quote by phone or WhatsApp. See https://www.btbanana.com/banana-prices.
